technical.summary: Long-term structure bullish but short-term momentum weak; oversold conditions present but lack confirmation signals for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: FE shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 19 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for FE; congressional trades are stale (348+ days old), market sentiment is balanced neutral, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 186 crisis level, macro_score -4) combined with earnings in 19 days creates hostile environment for FE utilities trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (EMA 50/200 bullish, Supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud) with price near support (35.7006) offers potential mean-reversion entry if oversold conditions trigger confirmation.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings in 19 days, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis level (186), zero fundamental support (no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, no smart money alignment), weak short-term momentum (price below EMA 9/21, MACD negative, no entry triggers), and ADX 16.24 (no trend confirmation) create a hostile risk/reward environment that outweighs technical structure.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term technical structure (EMA 50/200 bullish, Supertrend, Ichimoku) is constructive and price sits near support (35.7006), but this is insufficient to override macro hostility and earnings risk.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 19 days combined with inverted yield curve, VIX crisis level (186), and zero fundamental support (no insider buying, no smart money alignment) creates asymmetric downside risk that dominates any mean-reversion bounce.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias; technical bullishness is structural only, not actionable for swing entry
decision.portfolio_note: Already 13 positions in Utilities sector; adding FE increases concentration risk in hostile macro environment without conviction support.
